A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for sexual and reproductive health services grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SEXUAL AND REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH SERVICES GRANTS. +]

[+$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.925. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for sexual and reproductive health services grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SEXUAL AND REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH SERVICES GRANTS.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.925.
additions: APPROPRIATION; SEXUAL AND REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH SERVICES GRANTS.
$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.925.
